presets.name: Light CRM Profiles
presets.notes: Uses built-in question sets. Lets the CRM team choose and combine question sets within each customer type.

presets.name: Customer Profile Hub
presets.bestFor: Broad customer profile app with many question sets
presets.notes: Shows most built-in question sets, with combinations and focus areas enabled.

presets.name: Tutor Business Suite Profiles
presets.notes: Fixed Student, Guardian, Tutor and School forms. No question-set or focus controls in the UI.

presets.name: School & Training Profiles
presets.notes: Student enrolment, guardian contact, teacher/staff profile and school account.

presets.name: Therapy Practice Suite Profiles
presets.notes: Administrative intake only. Keep clinical notes, diagnoses and treatment records in a separate secure tool.

presets.name: Law Firm Client Profiles
presets.notes: Administrative client and conflict-check intake. Matters, advice and documents stay in a separate matter tool.

presets.name: Agency Client Profiles
presets.notes: Client account, prospect brief and supplier profile. Approvals and project delivery stay separate.

presets.name: Vendor & Procurement Profiles
presets.notes: Supplier, contractor and vendor contact forms. Evaluations, purchase orders and payments stay separate.

presets.name: Custom Vertical Template
presets.notes: One clean segment with one app-owned question set. Copy it and add real customer types.
